cases.translation: David asked the Lord about His will.

cases.sentence: Давид поднялся в ___ со своими двумя женами.
cases.translation: David went up to Hebron with his two wives.
cases.explain: Preposition 'в' with accusative case indicates movement toward a place.

cases.translation: They lived in the cities of Hebron.
cases.explain: Preposition 'в' with locative (prepositional) case indicates location.

cases.sentence: Жители Иудеи помазали Давида ___ над домом Иуды.
cases.translation: The people of Judah anointed David as king over the house of Judah.
cases.explain: The verb 'помазать' with instrumental case means 'to anoint as'.

cases.translation: Abner was the captain of Saul's army.
cases.explain: Predicative noun after 'был' in instrumental case.

cases.translation: He sent messengers to the king.
cases.explain: Direct object of the verb 'послал' requires accusative case.

cases.sentence: Давид правил семь лет и шесть ___ в Хевроне.
cases.translation: David reigned seven years and six months in Hebron.

cases.sentence: Авнер сказал Иаву, 'Пусть юноши встанут и сразятся перед ___.'
cases.translation: Abner said to Joab, 'Let the young men rise and play before me.'

reading.ru: После этого Давид спросил Господа, 'Идти ли мне в какой-нибудь из городов Иудеи?'
reading.question: What did David ask the Lord?
options: Whether to go to one of the cities of Judah
Whether to go to battle with the Philistines
Whether to build a new altar
reading.correct: Whether to go to one of the cities of Judah
reading.explain: David asked the Lord if he should go to one of the cities of Judah.

reading.ru: Жители Иудеи пришли в Хеврон и помазали там Давида царем над домом Иуды.
reading.question: What did the people of Judah do in Hebron?
options: They built a new temple for the ark
They anointed David as king over the house of Judah
They defeated the Philistines in battle
They established a new trade route
reading.correct: They anointed David as king over the house of Judah
reading.explain: The text states they 'помазали там Давида царем над домом Иуды'.

reading.ru: Авнер, сын Нира, начальник войска Саула, взял Ишбашета, сына Саула, и привел его в Маханаим.
reading.question: Where did Abner take Ishbosheth?
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'привел его в Маханаим' (brought him to Mahanaim).

reading.ru: Ишбашету, сыну Саула, было сорок лет, когда он стал царем Израиля, и правил он два года.
reading.question: How long did Ishbosheth reign over Israel?
reading.explain: The text states 'правил он два года' (he reigned two years).

reading.ru: Асаил был быстроног, как дикая серна.
reading.question: To what was Asahel compared in terms of speed?
reading.explain: The text says 'Асаил был быстроног, как дикая серна' (Asahel was swift of foot as a wild gazelle).

reading.ru: Авнер с обратным концом своего копья пронзил его в живот, так что оно вышло наружу у него через спину.
reading.question: How was Asahel killed?
options: With a sword through the heart
With the back end of a spear thrust through his body
With an arrow to the chest
reading.correct: With the back end of a spear thrust through his body
reading.explain: The text states Abner 'пронзил ему в живот обратным концом своего копья' (struck him in the body with the back end of his spear).
